name: Mango Sorbet
description: Frozen blended mango with a squeeze of lime. Refreshing and fruity dessert.

name: Chocolate Ice Cream
description: Rich churned dessert made with cocoa and cream, served frozen.

name: Frozen Yogurt Bark
description: Yogurt spread on a tray with berries and honey, then frozen and broken into pieces.

name: Chicken Noodle Soup
description: Slow-simmered broth with chicken, carrots, celery and egg noodles. Comforting and gentle on the stomach.

name: Ginger Lemon Soup
description: Clear broth with fresh ginger, garlic and lemon. Soothing when you feel unwell.

name: Banana Oat Muffins
description: Soft muffins made with oats and ripe bananas. Bake on Sunday, grab one on the way out.

name: Breakfast Burrito
description: Tortilla wrapped around scrambled eggs, beans and cheese. Easy to hold in one hand.

name: Seared Salmon with Lemon Butter
description: Crispy-skinned salmon fillet with a silky lemon butter sauce. Restaurant-style plating.

name: Mushroom Risotto
description: Creamy arborio rice slowly stirred with wild mushrooms, parmesan and white wine.

name: Red Lentil Curry
description: Red lentils simmered with coconut milk, tomato and spices. Plant-based and filling.

name: Chickpea Salad
description: Chickpeas, cucumber, tomato, parsley and lemon dressing. Plant-based and high in fibre.

name: Tofu Stir-Fry
description: Crispy tofu cubes with broccoli and peppers in soy-ginger sauce. Plant-based.

name: Beef Lasagna
description: Layers of pasta, beef ragù and béchamel baked until golden.

name: Margherita Pizza
description: Thin crust with tomato, mozzarella and basil, baked in a very hot oven.

name: Caesar Salad
description: Romaine lettuce, croutons, parmesan and creamy anchovy dressing.

name: Pancakes with Maple Syrup
description: Fluffy stacked pancakes served with butter and maple syrup. A lazy weekend favourite.

name: Grilled Cheese Sandwich
description: Toasted bread with melted cheddar. Ready in five minutes.

name: Tomato Soup
description: Smooth roasted tomato soup with basil and a swirl of cream.

name: Black Bean Tacos
description: Corn tortillas filled with spiced black beans, salsa and avocado. Plant-based.

name: Lamb Tagine
description: Slow-cooked lamb with apricots, almonds and warm spices, served with couscous.
